cutoff.meaning: The meeting ends at 4:00 PM Eastern Time on 12 March 2026; any votes cast after that time do not count.

negative_condition: The committee does not approve the request, meaning a majority of votes cast are against, or no decision is reached because the required votes are not cast before the meeting ends.
positive_condition: The committee approves the request, meaning a majority of votes cast are in favor.

proof.meaning: The official minutes of the 12 March meeting recording the motion and the votes of each member.
proof.name: meeting minutes
proof.subject: committee members

terminal_meaning: The committee's recorded votes under its own majority rule determine whether the compassionate-use request is approved or not at the 12 March meeting.
